items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Louie Armstrong playing with Fletcher Henderson; Interviewee confirms memory of the era but does not describe a personal relationship with Henderson.

ctx.x: Didn't have drums. Now, you picked them.
Let's see now, when you had Louie in 1924, he was playing with Fletcher Henderson, and that was in New York. Do you remember that?
